_comment: SINGLE canonical registration of the VALIDATE PRODUCER DEFINITION -- which check definition is currently allowed to mint a landing-authorizing receipt. Colocated with qualifying-receipt.json / rebase-base-floors.json. Task bind-receipt-to-producer-definition-not-only-the-gate-file.
_why: hermit #1579 bound the GATE FILE: the run's own .github/workflows/merge-gate.yml blob must equal vars.MERGE_GATE_V4_BLOB. It did NOT bind the PRODUCER. A PR could therefore present a CURRENT gate file while its receipt had been minted by an OLDER validate.sh -- i.e. by an older, weaker definition of what 'validated' means. That is the #231 shape (signal not bound to fact) applied to the producer instead of the consumer. This file is the producer-side half, symmetric with MERGE_GATE_V4_BLOB.
_not_hypothetical: Measured 2026-08-06: validate.sh blob was 9a9c31ce24abaa764089af7c4cafc820709c4c77 at hermit f89c69766371806d3c9b2c3003531df2d59d6118 and 836a070e5e02017ae232e243904fb033a5c45b17 at 4c70658e785834737cbe1524f77330c781a6f5ea -- the producer definition changed within 8 commits on main in a single day, while ci-portable.yml did not move. A receipt minted at the older head was produced by a different definition than the current one.
_rotation_2026_08_08: Audited rrnewton/hermit main b22e0f30700602f0f8fa92ff2895ad0d307f7542 and PR #1976 head 4a0733b4a56a4b3ed727be8bc4226b443c6df7c9: both resolve validate.sh to 349f8c0bae065597708019005180d2872d9c90b2 and ci-portable.yml to ef7cdc0211ebaeafcaba4286cb2374a80ab9f3fb. The delta from the previous registration adds validate re-entry/concurrency guards, makes the non-gating artifact purge opt-in, and installs the required rust-script interpreter on the strict-compat shard; it removes no validation gate, DAG lane, execution-count, or coverage obligation.
_generalises_the_anchor: The pre-anchor rule (a PR head must descend from hermit bfb0a9ef, else it runs its own older validate.sh) is a SINGLE-COMMIT ANCHOR: it goes stale every time the producer changes and must be hand-advanced. This registration is its hash-valued generalisation, exactly as #1579 generalised the gate-file case.
_semantics: EXACT SET EQUALITY, fail closed. A qualifying receipt MUST carry producer.definition whose key set and blob values equal `registered` exactly. A receipt with no producer block, a missing file, an extra file, or any differing blob is REFUSED -- refusing only on mismatch would let a stale producer omit the block and be waved through, which is the very fake-green shape this closes. An unreadable or malformed registration is a DEPLOY DEFECT (exit 2), never a lenient fallback.
_advancing_this: When validate.sh or ci-portable.yml legitimately changes on hermit main, update `registered` (and `registered_at`) in the SAME review that lands the producer change, then re-mint receipts. Landing a producer change without advancing this file will refuse every subsequent receipt -- loudly and at the gate, which is the intended failure direction.
